source.canonicalColorFormat: oklch in an @supports override; hex fallbacks in :root (recorded as hexFallback)

display.purpose: Room-hero h1 on interior pages (max 14ch). The house headline uses its own clamp (30–48px mobile in the snow band, 40–58px on the desktop lawn) in snow-white with a soft text shadow.

headline.purpose: Section h2; variants for 'Choose a room' (21–30px), two-up features (26–44px with an italic candle-gold em) and the letter (22–30px).

title.purpose: h3, story titles, gift-tag names (19px), event titles (18px), month headers (20px).

body.purpose: All copy at 17px/1.55 with oldstyle numerals; prose 18px/1.65 at 66ch; blurbs 15px/1.45; italics carry town, venue, dek and byline.

label.purpose: Controls and signs: plaques (15/14px), chips (14px), signs (13/15px), date plates (13px), captions (14px), text links (16px). Always Libre Caslon Text 700.

micro-label.purpose: Vollkorn 600–700 at 11–12px, +0.04 to +0.08em, uppercase: weekday on date plates, 'On now / This weekend' and audience badges, placeholder slot labels. The only uppercase settings in the system.

shadows.purpose: Gift tags hanging on the field.

shadows.purpose: Mobile brass sign under a window.

shadows.name: label-card-lip
shadows.purpose: A cream label card resting on a brass lip.

shadows.name: grain

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; every transition rides it.

motion.name: light-up
motion.value: opacity 0→1 over 420ms, delay calc(var(--i) * 220ms + 120ms) per glow in portal order (dormer-left, dining, living, dormer-right, door)
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: windows light left to right, door last, after the facade loads (2.5s fallback), then hold. Armed only by html.seq, which base.njk sets when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce; otherwise the windows render lit.

motion.name: warm
motion.purpose: A hovered or focused portal warms its glow overlay (class .is-warm set by app.js).

motion.name: sign-drop
motion.value: transform translate(-50%,6px)→translate(-50%,10px); 300ms; visibility delayed 300ms on hide
motion.purpose: The room sign drops under the window on hover/focus; the dining sign rises above its window on desktop.

motion.name: snowfall
motion.value: canvas bounded to .hero; ≤90 radial flakes r 0.6–2.2px, 16–46px/s, sine drift; DPR ≤2; starts on requestIdleCallback; pauses off-screen and on hidden tab
motion.purpose: Slow snow behind the house. Under reduced motion one static scatter is drawn (and redrawn on resize); the loop never starts.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: State transitions on controls and cards.

narrative.northStar: The Lit House in the Snow
narrative.overview:
The page is a house, not a page about a house. The home surface is a red-brick Georgian at night, every window glowing from inside, and its door and windows are the site's navigation. Every other page is the room behind one of those windows: the dining room (eat, drink and shop), the living room (outdoors), the foyer (events), the attic (stories), the bedroom (stay). The world is warm inside, cold outside: a night-navy sky with blue-shadowed snow and slow falling flakes outside; amber glow, brass, velvet red, holly green, damask paper and mahogany inside.

Everything interactive is a physical object from that house. Buttons are brass door plaques with two rivets. Cards are gift tags on a red string or photos in a mahogany frame with a green mat. Rules between movements are a garland plate; rules inside a section are a thin brass line. The FAQ is stockings on a mantel shelf. The newsletter is a letter in a brass mail slot. Dates on the events page are small brass plates. Nothing is glass, nothing blurs, nothing glows neon; the only light is amber window light and candle-gold focus rings.

Density is a campaign site on a phone: 390 px portrait is the design viewport, one saturated field per section, 17 px Vollkorn body, Caslon headings that stay large and few. Desktop widens to 1200 px and adds the lawn, the oaks, the fifth bay and the hanging wooden signs under each window; it does not add a second house or a second visual idea.
keyCharacteristics: Night-navy page ground, never black, never cream; cream and snow appear only as paper, cards and the funders band.
Each interior page owns one saturated field (dining red, holly green, damask-on-red foyer, attic dusk blue); accents inside a field are brass, candle gold and glow-core, never a second field colour.
Two self-hosted serifs: Libre Caslon Text 700 for every heading, label and control; Vollkorn for body, italics and metadata.
Components are house objects (plaque, tag, print, sign, stocking, letter, mail slot, garland); none of them is a generic card or pill.
One authored motion moment (windows light left to right, door last), one hover grammar (a window warms, its sign drops), snow bounded to the hero and static under reduced motion.
Film grain at 7% soft-light over the house and the room heroes; depth by inset bevels and soft drop shadows, not by layering blur.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: A section or room hero sits on exactly one field (night, red, damask-on-red, holly, bottle, dusk, chintz, snow). Within it, the only accents are brass, candle gold, glow-core and cream paper; a second field colour never appears as an accent.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Cream and snow are objects (tag, letter, label card, funders band), never the page. The page is always night.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Yellow Rule
rules.body: Brand yellow `#FFD300` exists only inside the Wander logo lockups; no CSS token carries it and no surface may introduce it.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: House light is warm amber (glow / glow-core) and nothing else. No multicolour lights on the facade; the tree's ornaments inside the living-room window are the single exception the render carries.

rules.name: The Caslon Controls Rule
rules.body: Anything you can press or read as a sign is set in Libre Caslon Text 700: plaques, chips, signs, date plates, links, captions. Vollkorn never appears on a control.

rules.name: The Italic Metadata Rule
rules.body: Secondary facts (town, venue, duration, dek, byline) are Vollkorn italic at 15px, never a kicker above the title. "St. Catharines and the Benchlands" lives in the first line of copy, never as a kicker.

rules.name: The One Large Type Rule
rules.body: The headline is the only large type in the first viewport; the house, the snow and the plaque rail carry everything else at label size.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Nothing uses `backdrop-filter`, translucency over imagery or blurred panels. Overlays (sticky bar, modal backdrop) are night-deep at 82–92% alpha, flat.

rules.name: The Soft-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every drop shadow is black at 18–50% alpha with blur at least twice its offset. There are no hard offset shadows; the only solid offset is the 2px brass lip under a label card.

dos: Do set every new page on night and give each new section one field (`.field--night`, `--red`, `--damask`, `--green`, `--bottle`, `--dusk`, `--chintz`, `--snow`); use brass, candle gold, glow-core and cream objects as the accents inside it.
Do make every button a `.plaque` (or `.plaque--sm`) and every secondary action a `.tlink`; both are Libre Caslon Text 700.
Do present a business, itinerary or place as a gift tag with name / town / type in that order, and a photo or story as a framed print with a bottle-green mat.
Do give every control a 3px candle-gold `:focus-visible` outline (3px offset; 2px on chips and inputs; −3px inside stockings) and a 44px minimum target.
Do keep "St. Catharines and the Benchlands" in the first line of copy (headline or subline) on every page.
Do carry the brass texture plate on every brass surface (plaques, date plates, mobile signs) and the 7% soft-light grain on heroes.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: windows render lit, snow renders as a static scatter, smooth scroll is off.
Do add new portals, labels and destinations in `src/_data/portals.json`, never by hand in templates; array order is the light-up order, `priority` is tab order.
donts: Don't put cream, parchment or snow under a page or section as ground; cream and snow are paper and funders band only (The Paper Rule).
Don't use `backdrop-filter`, glass panels, blur, neon, purple or gradient text anywhere.
Don't add coloured or multicolour lights to the house or to the glow plates; house light is amber only.
Don't use brand yellow `#FFD300` outside the Wander logo lockups.

Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings; secondary facts go in Vollkorn italic beneath the title, and the only uppercase settings are the 11–12px micro labels on date plates, badges and placeholders.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons; the only icons are inline SVG social marks and the stocking, garland, mail-slot and evergreen plates.
Don't render a second house, a second facade crop or a photo-hero-plus-cards layout on any page; the house is seen once, on the home page, at one scale.
Don't break the "Choose a room" rail into cards or add a hamburger menu; the house and the plaque rail are the mobile navigation.
Don't add a second authored animation; the light-up, the warming and the snow are the whole motion budget.
